description: A compact Codex digital pet: A Codex digital pet duo of Crayon Shin-chan and Shiro. Keep the pair together in every frame: Shin-chan as the main small chibi figure with thick eyebrows, simple round face, red top, yellow shorts, white socks, and yellow shoes; Shiro as the small white dog companion beside him. Preserve the simple cartoon look from the references, but simplify it into Codex pet sprite form. The pair should read as one combined pet silhouette with Shin-chan leading and Shiro close at his side.
